Scope and methodology

This pack summarises the resilience testing evidence Tumult recorded for the DORA framework over the period 2026-11-17 – 2026-11-24; 11 experiments are on record. An automated experiment is a chaos or continuity test that Tumult ran. The outcome of a run is the status that run recorded; a manual exercise has the outcome of its verified record.

Independence

Independence verified: 0 of 11 tests name an external tester.

The count reads the tester each manual record names. A run names its tester only in its journal, which the lake does not keep, so no run counts as naming one.

Organizational separation of test design/execution from service operation requires a reviewed attestation. Manual evidence review records identify the enterer and verifier; those identities alone do not prove organizational independence.

Traceability matrix

Each row is a row of the DORA requirement registry, version 2026.11.2, scored for Demo Firm (LEI 529900T8BM49AURSDO55) under the simplified profile as of 2026-11-24, as GET /api/dora scores it. The status is the evidence status of the row: none, designed, existing or operating, or unknown, no events or not applicable when it cannot be scored. The evidence is the best run or manual record behind each function the row binds. A status says what evidence is held. It is not a compliance verdict.

Approval chain (change management)

Approval-gated runs (tiers T1–T3) execute only after explicit human approval — the change-management evidence for SOC 2 CC8.1. Each request pins the exact change content by hash, enforces an approver quorum with segregation of duties, and lapses on a TTL; approvals are single-use and break-glass overrides carry a mandatory justification. Pin hashes are re-verified at dispatch, and the full per-run, hash-chained `run_audit` trail is available via the API. Runs are shown by their id prefix; the full id and pin hash are available via the run-detail API.

Approval-chain appendix: at most the 500 newest installation records are sampled, then filtered to this scope and period. This appendix is not a complete approval export; use the portable run_audit and approval tables for complete evidence.
